objective: Minimise population FGT1 over a threshold in the existing out-of-fold PMT ranking, at the main equal-net-cost fiscal constraint.

bootstrap.description: Conditional re-optimisation over all evaluated coverages; fitted PMT, equilibria, payments and poverty line are fixed. No PMT re-fitting or design-based population inference.

pmt_design.method: Household-level out-of-fold ridge, person-weighted log1p equivalent income; fold-local preprocessing
pmt_design.interpretation: Within-survey validation; geographic and administrative transportability require external validation

interpretation: A numerically refined minimum from the stated global-grid and household-boundary search, conditional on the survey and model. The search is not a mathematical certificate over every possible continuous coverage or every targeting method.
